target: 哈姆雷特: 四万个兄弟的爱加在一起，也抵不过我的爱——

source: Hamlet: Oh, you can't imagine life without her? You, who would leave her to gallivant around Paris? Forty thousand brothers could not, with all their quantity of love, make up my sum—
target: 哈姆雷特: 哦，你无法想象没有她的生活？你可是会丢下她，跑去巴黎寻欢作乐的人啊？ 四万个兄弟的爱加在一起，也抵不过我的爱——

source: Laertes: I love you. I want you to live on. I can't imagine a complete life without you. Hamlet: Oh, you can't imagine life without her? You, who would leave her to gallivant around Paris? Forty thousand brothers could not, with all their quantity of love, make up my sum— Polonius: Stop that, lads. Stop bickering. Need everything be a competition with you two?
target: 雷欧提斯: 我爱你。我希望你继续活下去。我无法想象，没有你的人生还能完整。 哈姆雷特: 哦，你无法想象没有她的生活？你可是会丢下她，跑去巴黎寻欢作乐的人啊？ 四万个兄弟的爱加在一起，也抵不过我的爱—— 波洛涅斯: 够了，小伙子们。别吵了。你们两个非得什么事都争个高下吗？
